notes.title: Survivor Cells Update is Here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/1f69c8bd06a08832c78041f63b8cf868cbc56b65.png

Survivor Cells has just received a fantastic update! Get ready to explore all the new features and take your gaming experience to the next level!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/7b2b7db2ffb2784f934334bc9ec7ab5131c748e9.gif

- New Game Mode: Endless  
Now you can test your limits in the new Endless mode! Survive as long as possible against endless waves of enemies in a never-ending gameplay experience. Start the mode already at Year 100 with upgrades purchased in the laboratory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/fc38ae8490b7bc7e1233db916cedded37b50ef42.gif

- Alchemy Improvements  
The Alchemy system has been refined, making strategy creation even more dynamic. Adjusting your build during gameplay is now more intuitive and effective!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/ad3a7fe3179e7392b551be77af6dec16efa4cb1d.gif

- Laboratory Enhancements  
The Laboratory has been updated to make managing your cells and resources easier, making your decisions more strategic and practical.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/e34e423cf05c1842f9a60f3254041c405ed764bb.gif

- Various Fixes and Gameplay & Navigation Improvements  
We’ve implemented numerous fixes and improvements that make gameplay and navigation smoother and more engaging, ensuring a more enjoyable experience.

- New SFX  
To further enhance your immersion, we've added new sound effects that will make your battles even more exciting!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/16cfe50711f9e65f590827764194d75799503578.gif

Update your game now and enjoy all these improvements!  
Get ready to face new challenges and take your survival to the next level!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1976100/Survivor_Cells/

notes.title: Next Update! - News and Information!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/8d71c20dc00d20ab98f1aee31ab2a5a40677ae51.png

Hello, Everyone!

We are incredibly excited to announce that Survivor Cells is about to receive its first major update, scheduled for January 30th. Get ready for a true feast of improvements, adjustments, and innovations that will take your gaming experience to a whole new level!

In our constant quest for perfection, we will be resetting the ranks to implement crucial fixes and enhance the ranking system. This will ensure an even fairer and more balanced competitive environment for all players.

And the good news doesn't stop there! To celebrate this incredible milestone with the 1st Major Update, we are offering a special discount throughout this week. It's the perfect opportunity to join the adventure if you haven't already and secure the free DLC!

Mark your calendars:
-> January 30th!
Don't miss out on these exciting updates that will elevate your Survivor Cells experience to a new level.

Remember that we highly value your feedback; it's invaluable to us. We appreciate you being part of the Survivor Cells community. Be ready for an exciting journey, and we'll see you in the cells! 🦠🔬

***The DLC will be free only during the Early Access period of the game, so be sure to download it to register it in your Steam account. After the official launch, it will be a paid DLC!
